title: bring back "auto-lock screen on login" option from KDM/Plasma 4
line: The Login Screen settings gain a "Lock after automatically logging in" option, so an autologin boot goes straight to the lock screen.
explanation: Plasma's login manager could log a user in automatically but always handed over an unlocked desktop, so there was no way to boot into a ready session that still needs a password, as KDM allowed. kscreenlocker already locks at startup when logind's LockedHint is set on the session, but nothing set it. This is Oliver Beard's open plasma-login-manager!203, rebased on master: the helper now reports the new session's id, and when autologin and the new Autologin/Lock setting are on, the daemon sets LockedHint and calls Lock on that session through logind; the KCM gets a checkbox for it next to "Log in again immediately after logging off".

commits.message:
autologin: add option to lock the session after logging in

Automatic login always opened an unlocked session. A new option in the
KCM, off by default, makes the daemon mark the autologin session locked
through logind, so the user boots straight to the lock screen.

BUG: 346741

media.caption: Login Screen settings on master with auto-login on: no option to lock the session.
With the patch: "Lock after automatically logging in" under the auto-login options, ticked (Apply enabled). It greys out when auto-login is off.
An autologin-style session (logind wayland/user session) starting today: straight to the unlocked desktop.
Same session after the daemon's new logind calls (SetLockedHint + Lock): Plasma starts on the lock screen.
